Alex: Overnight bridge handoff — quick async standup.
Alex: What I did: prewarmed AMS1 lane to 40% (50 GPUs), drained node-045 for kernel update, ran smoke tests on canary model routing.
Alex: Blockers: APAC spot churn caused ~6m queue spikes around 03:12 UTC; noticed a small memory leak in runtime on node-078, opened issue #3819.
Priya: Thx Alex. I scaled fallback pool +4 GPUs in APAC via terraform; ran `terraform apply -target=module.fallback_pool` (no drift). :white_check_mark:
Priya: Also added a short-circuit in request router to favor dedicated pool for critical customers until quotas stabilize.
Matt: CI flagged missing nvidia driver on node-045 after reboot, reimaging now. ETA ~20m.
Jia: FYI started canary for autoscaler PR #421 — routing 5% traffic to new policy. Watching latency and error rate.
Sarah: Left a comment on #421 about readinessProbe 5s -> 10s; without that the canary failed 1 probe and caused a restart loop.
DeployBot: Deployment triggered by Jia: autoscaler/canary-2026-03-17 (build 2134). Rolling update: 6 -> 10 replicas. Status: in_progress.
Alex: Can someone ping @infra-sre for a temporary quota bump in APAC (requested +8 GPUs). Raised ticket INC-3821.
Priya: Attached perf snapshot: https://redwood.internal/ops/snapshots/174561 — tail shows qlen spike and >95th latency at 03:12 UTC.
Matt: Quick ask: can reviewers look at my small fix for node reimage script? PR #439 — it's blocking nightly drains.
Sarah: Reviewing now, should be able to merge in next 30m.
Alex: Thanks — I'll update the handoff doc and mark items done when resolved. :thumbsup:
